reply.text:
The runbook's hotfix path requires one approval before merge, and the PR is still waiting on Sam, who is out of office. I won't merge without that approval or bypass branch protection. The fastest safe route is to find another approver who can review it now. I'll check who else can approve.

TOOL: cat .github/CODEOWNERS 2>/dev/null || echo "no CODEOWNERS file"
TOOL: gh pr view 77 --json title,headRefName,files,additions,deletions,author
TOOL: gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/collaborators --jq '.[] | select(.permissions.maintain or .permissions.admin) | .login'
